prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A cluttered office desk after a lively celebration, captured in a cinematic, shallow depth-of-field style. The foreground is dominated by a chaotic array of party remnants: colorful streamers, deflated and partially inflated balloons in red and orange, crumpled paper cups, used plates with leftover cake, and scattered confetti. A slice of cake sits on a striped paper plate atop a stack of disorganized folders and paperwork, hinting at a hasty, impromptu party. The desk is also littered with plastic utensils, napkins, and a tipped-over party hat. A computer monitor and keyboard are visible on the right, partially obscured by the mess, with some streamers draped over the screen. The lighting is cool and slightly moody, with soft blue and gray tones dominating the palette, punctuated by the bright, festive colors of the party supplies. The background is softly blurred, focusing attention on the chaotic aftermath in the foreground. The overall mood is one of post-celebration exhaustion, with a sense of realism and narrative depth, as if the viewer has stumbled upon the scene moments after the festivities ended. The camera angle is slightly above desk level, offering a candid, immersive perspective into the disarray.
